name: AK-47
summary: **AK-47** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Serious Seeds]] in the Netherlands, first released in 1992. A cross of [[colombian-gold|Colombian Gold]], [[mexican-sativa|Mexican Sativa]], [[thai|Thai]], and [[afghani|Afghani]] genetics, developed by founder Simon after years of selecting experimental lines. It is sativa-dominant, at roughly a 65:35 sativa-to-indica ratio.
